Keep the prayer for resistance to hostile attacks in its own voice.
shortened: O Lord, O Lord! Assist him with a heavenly power and a divine might, that he may resist the onslaught of the enemies and the attacks of the hateful ones, and triumph over the oppressors, and that Thy conquering victory may be made manifest over all things.

order.why: Consider protection and heavenly assistance for those who aid the wronged.
Read the prayer for renewed sight and reliance after concealment and absence.
Hear protection from illness and hardship sought for the sake of service.
shortened: Then clothe him in the armor of Thy protection, and preserve him from every disease and hardship and calamity and ailment and pain, that he may aid Thee in Thy dominion and make mention of Thee amidst Thy creatures.

order.why: Read love and reliance as the basis of asking assistance.
Consider tranquility of heart amid oppression.
Hear the request that objections and opposition not prevent service.
Read firmness in love beside the prayer’s account of sacrifice.
Consider steadfastness that is not governed by kings or changing circumstances.
Hear the petition for constancy despite distracting words and allusions.
Read the specific plea not to be weakened by princely power.
shortened: I beseech Thee to assist me to aid Thy Cause among Thy creatures in such wise that the power of princes shall not weaken me.

order.why: Consider the prayer’s love, detachment, and service among others.
shortened: Say: O my God and my Master! I beseech Thee by the Lamp of Thy Revelation whereby Thy heaven and earth were illumined, and by the tribulations of the Dayspring of Thy signs Who hath been afflicted amidst the wrongdoers among Thy creatures, to make me one of those who in Thy love have detached themselves from all else but Thee, who have arisen to serve Thee amongst Thy servants, and who have been so carried away by the breezes of Thy love that they have cast behind them all that is on earth in manifesting Thy Cause and exalting Thy Word.

order.why: Read thirst for reunion leading toward assistance.
Hear the prayer’s aim of making mercy universal.
shortened: This is Your servant who has clung to the hem of Your favors and been attracted by Your holy fragrances and been ignited by the fire kindled in the Tree of Your oneness and has arisen with all his strength to exalt Your Word and spread Your sweet savors and cause Your lights to shine forth and Your mysteries to be revealed and to magnify Your signs and adorn Your banners and proclaim Your virtues and make universal Your mercies.

order.why: Consider joy for hearts and eyes as a requested result of assistance.
shortened: I implore Thee, O my Lord, by Thy surpassing majesty and Thine Ancient Name, to enable Thy loved ones to assist Thee. Direct, then, continually their faces towards Thy face, and write down for them what will cause all hearts to exult and all eyes to be gladdened.

order.why: Read service to God and to the loved ones together.
shortened: I beseech Thee by the treasuries of Thy knowledge and the repositories of Thy wisdom, and by Thy Most Great Command and Thy Most Ancient Name, to assist me in all conditions to serve Thee and to serve Thy loved ones, and to ordain for me that which befitteth Thy glory and Thy majesty, Thy Cause and Thy sovereignty.

order.why: Join steadfast service with becoming an aid to other people.
Hear the petition to act through wisdom and utterance according to the Book.
shortened: Then I beseech Thee, O Lord of existence and Sovereign over the seen and unseen, by the pearls of the ocean of Thy knowledge and Thy hidden and treasured mysteries in Thy tablets, to make me among those who have aided Thy Cause through wisdom and utterance and have done what Thou hast commanded them in the Book.

order.why: Consider kindling hearts and being preserved for service.
Read the request for a helper worthy of the divine name.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O my God, to manifest for the victory of this Revelation one who is worthy of Thy Name and Thy sovereignty, that he may remember Thee amongst Thy creation and raise the standards of Thy triumph in Thy realm.

order.why: Hear the wish to share in what is ordained for those who arise.
Read the desire to speak praise amid differing factions.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Bestower of bounties and Lord of all peoples, to ordain for me through the Pen of Thy will that which shall render me a helper of Thy Cause and one who speaks Thy praise amidst the factions.

order.why: Consider the prayer’s request to be among those who serve.
Hear remembrance and exaltation sought among created beings.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which all names have bowed down, that Thou aid me in that which will cause Thy Cause to be exalted amongst Thy creation and Thy remembrance amongst Thy servants.

order.why: Join steadfastness with becoming a herald.
shortened: I beseech Thee to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and a herald of Thy Name amongst Thy servants.

order.why: Read the shared request for help in remembering and making the Cause known.
Retain the related concise prayer for aid and remembrance.
Consider generosity that benefits people beyond their present world.
shortened: O Lord! Aid Thy loved ones to remember and praise Thee, then ordain for them from Thy generosity that which will profit them in Thy worlds.

order.why: Hear the hope that service may endure in remembrance.
shortened: We implore God to assist His loved ones in that which will today cause the exaltation of His Cause, that their mention may endure forever.

order.why: Read prayer for fellow workers and their confirmation.
Consider assistance and entry into the precincts of oneness together.
shortened: O my Lord! Assist me to aid Thy Cause and to enter the precincts of the glory of Thy oneness.

order.why: End the petition sequence with the simplest request for help in serving.
Hear the assurance of divine presence with continual service.
shortened: Aid your Lord, the All-Merciful, at all times. Verily He is with you, and He hath power over all things.

order.why: Consider what endures when presently visible things pass away.
Close with the benediction on assistance renewed at daybreak and sunset.
shortened: And the Spirit and Glory be upon thee and upon those who have aided their Lord, the Most Merciful, at every daybreak and sunset.

questions: How does the assertion that God needs no help change your understanding of being a helper?
What might victory over one’s own self involve before attempting to influence another heart?
How do wisdom, understanding, good words, and righteous deeds shape the meaning of the military metaphors?
What does Qur’an 61:14 illuminate through the disciples’ answer to Jesus, and what distinctive explanation does this compilation offer?
How could the value placed on very small efforts change the way a community recognizes service?
What signs might distinguish an enduring spiritual result from immediate outward success, especially amid difficulty?

references.label: 1 · Qur’an 61:14 · The disciples as helpers
references.note: Read Pickthall’s rendering of the call to become God’s helpers, the disciples’ response to Jesus, and the concluding account of divine support. Compare this reciprocal language of assistance with the compilation’s explanation that God is independent and that the helper’s own heart must change. Keep the texts’ particular accounts of victory in view.
